gitHooks.name: commit-msg
gitHooks.does: Rejects AI attribution, affirmatory language, and subjects over 72 characters.

gitHooks.name: pre-commit
gitHooks.does: Prints an advisory when source changes land without plan, docs, or component manifest changes.

gitHooks.name: pre-push
gitHooks.does: Blocks a push when the branch diff lacks plan, docs, or component manifest changes.

skills.name: ravintio-file-backlog
skills.description: Files one uncommitted backlog entry in another repo. Finds or creates plan/backlog/ there, reserves the next id from plan/backlog/.next-id, writes plan/backlog/{id}-{slug}/entry.md, and reports the path. Never touches the target repo's git state. Invoke on request ("file a backlog entry in {repo}", "add this to the backlog of {repo}").

skills.name: ravintio-implement
skills.description: Implements requirements with tests and documentation landing together through the TDD loop. Invoked during the implement phase.

skills.name: ravintio-implementer
skills.description: TDD green phase: writes the minimum code to make one failing test pass and confirms GREEN (zero exit). Invoked by ravintio-implement after ravintio-test-writer confirms RED.

skills.name: ravintio-initiative
skills.description: Coordinates an initiative from chart to delivery in the human's session. Charts the steps, activates the branch, starts the driver and a watch monitor, reports progress, queues backlog entries, and delivers the initiative PR. Never resumes or runs a step. Loaded when an initiative is active and the session is not a step session.

skills.name: ravintio-loop-runner
skills.description: Canonical loop mechanics for every pipeline loop: state file conventions, stop rules, escalation format, toggle protocol. Loaded by any phase agent entering a loop.

skills.name: ravintio-migrator
skills.description: Executes a pending RAVINTIO Zero migration interactively. Reads a migration file, presents findings to the human, applies confirmed changes, and records the result in the migration ledger. Invoked by the orchestrator when pending migrations are detected.

skills.name: ravintio-optimise-agent
skills.description: Reviews ravintio-zero/skills/ for superfluous content and presents one suggestion at a time for human confirmation. Never modifies files.

skills.name: ravintio-orchestrator
skills.description: Owns discovery and routing for the five-phase RAVINTIO pipeline. Coaches a human from feature brief to confirmed design, then invokes the plan, implement, validate-and-accept, and ship phase skills in sequence.

skills.name: ravintio-plan
skills.description: Produces the plan-phase artifact set (requirements, ADRs, scope, risks, glossary) behind one human gate. Invoked by the orchestrator during the plan phase.

skills.name: ravintio-postmortem
skills.description: Writes one blameless postmortem for a failed CI run, a Blocked stop, a P2 self-correction, an escaped defect, or a human request. Builds a timeline and a 5 whys chain that ends at a process or tool gap, files each action, and writes the record to plan/postmortems/. Invoked by the orchestrator after a Resolved line, or on request.

skills.name: ravintio-refactor
skills.description: TDD refactor phase: improves code quality while keeping all tests passing. Invoked by ravintio-implement after ravintio-implementer confirms GREEN.

skills.name: ravintio-refresh-setup
skills.description: Refreshes a RAVINTIO install by detecting the target tool, reading the tracked `plan/state/{tool}.md` record first, falling back to the flags-used marker file and then installed hook wiring, confirming with the human on the loop, and re-invoking setup.sh/setup.ps1 with those flags. Invoke on request ("refresh the RAVINTIO setup", "re-run setup with current settings", "refresh setup for {tool}").

skills.name: ravintio-retrospective
skills.description: Writes one blameless retrospective for a shipped run or a delivered initiative. Reviews what helped, what slowed the work, and what to try next, files each change, and writes the record to plan/retrospectives/. Invoked by ship after the build report and by I-E Delivery before the initiative PR, or on request.

skills.name: ravintio-ship
skills.description: Archive, build assessment, changelog, version, and PR, behind the final gate in a gated run.

skills.name: ravintio-test-writer
skills.description: TDD red phase: writes exactly one failing test per requirement and confirms RED (non-zero exit). Invoked by ravintio-implement for each requirement in the TDD inner loop.

skills.name: ravintio-validate-and-accept
skills.description: CI, security review, execution verification, and the acceptance gate or PR evidence.
